tooltip_popover.title: Currency and Length Conversions
tooltip_popover.example: Honeybee body length: Head 2.3 cm + Thorax 5.4 cm + Abdomen 7.5 cm = 15.2 cm total.

tooltip_popover.title: Equivalent Decimals and Vertical Alignment
tooltip_popover.description: Appending trailing zeros to decimal places preserves value (0.2 = 0.20 = 0.200).
tooltip_popover.example: Comparing 0.2 and 0.09: 0.2 has 2 tenths while 0.09 has 0 tenths, so 0.2 > 0.09.

image_asset.title: Decimals Sub-Unit Measurement & Equivalent Grid Diagram

hotspots.title: Millimeter Subdivisions
hotspots.popover_content: 1 cm = 10 mm => 1 mm = 0.1 cm. Sub-unit subdivisions allow measuring exact fractional lengths.

hotspots.title: Expanded Decimal Grid
hotspots.popover_content: Place values right of decimal: Tenths (0.1), Hundredths (0.01), Thousandths (0.001).

hotspots.title: Equivalent Decimals & Alignment
hotspots.popover_content: Trailing zeros do not alter value: 0.2 = 0.20 = 0.200. Always align decimal points vertically.
